item.description:
​

<Track List>​

01. 목소리 (Produced by Slow Rabbit)
02. Do You (Original Beat By Major Lazer - Aerosol Can)
03. 각성 (Original Beat By Big K.R.I.T. - The Alarm)
04. Monster (Original Beat By J. Cole - Grown Simba)
05. 버려 (Original Beat By Chase & Status - Hypest Hype)
06. 농담 (Original Beat By Run The Jewels - Oh My Darling)
07. God Rap (Original Beat By J. Cole - God's Gift) ★다운로드 받는 폴더에 있어요.
08. Rush (Feat. Krizz Kaliko) (Produced by Pdogg)
09. Life (Original Beat By J. Dilla - Life)
10. 표류 (Original Beat By Drake - Lust 4 Life)
11. I Believe (Produced by Slow Rabbit)

The mixtape was issued in a .zip file format under the title "RM-Mixtape.zip". Size: 121MB (zipped), 134MB (unzipped).

The folder's contents (when unzipped) include:
- 11 .mp3 files (320kbps) containing all songs from the mixtape (in the folder entitled "Mp3")
- 11 .txt files, which contain lyrics to all songs from the mixtape (in the folder entitled "Lyrics")
- A 13-page .pdf document, containing the cover, as well as the previously mentioned lyrics (titled "RM Booklet.pdf")
- and an 800x800 .jpg file of the mixtape's cover (titled "RM Cover.jpg").
